next_step: Closed-lost. Leave nurture sequence; send notes on streaming-tail improvements and invite to private on-prem pilot in H2 2026.
loss_reason: Technical - p95 tail latency for streaming long-context sessions exceeded customer SLO. Oakridge required p95 <=250ms across NA and EU; POC observed p95 520-900ms on peak workloads. Competitor NebulaServe offered appliance + optimized streaming stack with contractual SLO and immediate on-prem integration. Hiring/procurement hold in Dec accelerated decision to choose competitor.
notes:
CRM-style timeline and notes:
- 2025-07-22: Initial qual (Diego + Priya). Oakridge builds agent assist for enterprise portals, 50k monthly active agents, need sub-250ms p95 for interactive flows and persistent 20k token context.
- 2025-08-10: SE deep dive (Priya + runtime team). Identified risk: streaming chunking + KV cache coverage for very long contexts; recommended dedicated clusters and edge placements.
- 2025-09-01: POC kickoff — Redwood provisioned dedicated in us-east and eu-west; on-prem eval discussed.
- 2025-09-30: Mid-POC sync (ff_2025-09-14-2233): median latencies good ~100-200ms. p95 tail inconsistent: 520-750ms on mixed-length streams. Traces point to GC pauses in some runtime versions and cross-region routing for large KV fetches.
- 2025-10-12: Performance run: applied streaming buffer tuning, reduced chunk size, enabled aggressive KV prefetch, switched to quantized kernels. P95 improved to ~430-520ms but still above requirement.
- 2025-11-18: Security review requested additional residency proof and HSM/KMS implementation timeline. Redwood provided docs; legal asked for SLA on latency.
- 2025-12-02: Procurement paused (hiring freeze). Competitor NebulaServe demonstrated on-prem box with hardware acceleration, claimed p95 <250ms guaranteed.
- 2026-01-20: Final call - Oakridge chose NebulaServe. Key quote: "We need predictable interactivity; our ops team won't accept intermittent stalls." - Lina Q., Head of Platform.
- Postmortem bullets:
  * Primary cause: tail latency under long-context streaming workload; improvements touched median but not tail due to runtime/docker GC and network amplification for KV misses.
  * What we tried: dedicated pools, region-local routing, kernel reorder, smaller chunk sizes, aggressive prefetch, telemetry enhancement.
  * Commercial: loss compounded by procurement freeze and lack of an exec champion after Champion (Head of Platform) changed role in Nov.
  * Competitive factor: NebulaServe offered appliance + white-glove integration + SLO in contract.
- Recommended next actions: document streaming-tail mitigations including GC fixes and kernel patch notes, offer re-engagement email in 6 months, invite to H2 pilot of on-prem streaming accelerator.
- Internal owner notes: SE Priya to compile traces and submit RW-4722 ticket summary for infra optimizations.
